page.title.index: Slotwise — Your calendar, inside your chat
hero.title:
Your calendar,
inside your chat
hero.subtitle: Schedule meetings, check your agenda, and manage your time — all from a simple WhatsApp message.

chat.msg1: What does my Tuesday look like?
chat.msg2:
You have 2 meetings:

how.label: How it works
how.title: Scheduling should be this simple
how.step1.title: Message Slotwise
how.step1.desc: Send a WhatsApp message like you would to any friend. No app to download, no new interface to learn.
how.step2.title: Say what you need
how.step2.desc: "Schedule a call with Laura this week" or "Am I free Thursday afternoon?" — just talk naturally.
how.step3.title: It just happens
how.step3.desc: Events get created, conflicts get flagged, invites get sent. Your calendar stays in sync — you stay in your chat.
bottom.title:
Stop switching apps
to manage your time
bottom.desc: Start with 10 free bookings every month. Need more? See pricing.

pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.

pricing.pro.name: Pro

contact.title: Contact us

contact.form.success: Message sent! We'll get back to you soon.
upgrade.success.title: You're on Pro!
upgrade.success.desc: Your subscription is active. Return to WhatsApp — Slotwise will pick up wherever you left off, including any booking that was pending.
upgrade.success.subtext: Manage your subscription or get help anytime at contact@slotwise.eu
upgrade.cancelled.title: Checkout cancelled
upgrade.cancelled.desc: No charge was made. You can come back to upgrade anytime from WhatsApp — just send another scheduling request when you're ready.
